question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate word. Choose the correct alternative.**

Be it a chaat or a refreshing lemonade, lemon is the need of the hour in _______ summers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **scorching.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Banging**: A continuing very loud noise. (लगातार बहुत तेज आवाज)
 
• **Freezing**: Extremely cold or turning to ice. (अत्यधिक ठंडा या बर्फ में बदल जाना)
 
• **Scorching**: Burning; very hot. (जलता हुआ; बहुत गर्म)
 
 
• **For example- ***It was **scorching **hot inside the greenhouse.*
 
 
 
• **Alleviating**: To make pain or problems less severe. (दर्द या समस्याओं को कम गंभीर बनाने के लिए)
 
 
 
• ​As per the meaning of the given words "**Scorching**" is the most appropriate word.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence:** *Be it a chaat or a refreshing lemonade, lemon is the need of the hour in scorching __summers.*
